Last meaningful update: 2026-05-18

# Mines - Math, RNG And Fairness Spec

Output di `WP-MINES-MATH-CERTIFICATION-READY`.

> Current runtime note (2026-05-18): sections 1-10 preserve the retroactive
> certification discovery for the former 90% table. The active demo runtime was
> raised to 98% by `WP-MINES-MATH-FIX-RTP-98`; see section 11 for the current
> formula, multiplier table, RTP model and validation target.

Questo documento formalizza retroattivamente la math Mines effettiva gia' in runtime. Non cambia payout, RNG, fairness, API, schema o frontend: documenta il comportamento osservato in `backend/app/modules/games/mines/runtime.py`, `randomness.py`, `fairness.py` e nell'allegato runtime `docs/runtime/CasinoKing_Documento_07_Allegato_B_Payout_Runtime_v1.json`.

## 1. Scope

| Campo | Valore |
| --- | --- |
| Game code | `mines` |
| Runtime grid sizes | `9`, `16`, `25`, `36`, `49` cells (`3x3`, `4x4`, `5x5`, `6x6`, `7x7`) |
| Mine counts | `1..grid_size - 1`, as present in the runtime table |
| Runtime payout source | `docs/runtime/CasinoKing_Documento_07_Allegato_B_Payout_Runtime_v1.json` |
| Backend lookup | `backend/app/modules/games/mines/runtime.py::get_multiplier` |
| Effective RTP band from runtime table | `90.0100%..90.0194%` depending on rounding/config/step |
| Historical design note | Documento 07 mentions 2.0% nominal house edge; the current runtime table is the source of truth and prices near 90.01% RTP. |
| Max win cap | Not applied in Mines runtime math. |
| Frontend math | Forbidden; frontend displays backend values only. |
| Wallet/ledger/platform rounds | Out of scope for this WP and untouched. |
| External research | Not used. |

## 2. Formula

Mines runtime does not calculate multipliers live from a floating formula during gameplay. It loads a frozen payout table and performs an exact table lookup.

```text
multiplier(grid_size, mine_count, safe_reveals_count) =
  payout_table[grid_size][mine_count][safe_reveals_count - 1]

potential_payout = round_6(bet_amount * multiplier)
```

The actuarial formula used to validate each frozen table row is the standard cumulative Mines survival probability:

```text
cells = grid_size
mines = mine_count
k = safe_reveals_count

success_probability(cells, mines, k) = C(cells - mines, k) / C(cells, k)
theoretical_rtp(cells, mines, k) = success_probability * runtime_multiplier
fair_multiplier(cells, mines, k) = 1 / success_probability
```

The runtime table values are therefore the certification object. Across all supported rows the actual `theoretical_rtp` computed from table values is between `0.900100` and `0.900194`. This is close to a 90.01% RTP target after 4-decimal multiplier rounding, not the older nominal 98%/2% design note.

Rounding:

| Value | Runtime rule |
| --- | --- |
| Multipliers | Loaded as decimals from JSON and formatted to 4 decimals in API responses. |
| Payout amount | `bet_amount * multiplier`, quantized to 6 decimals. |
| Probabilities/RTP in this spec | Calculated analytically from combinations and runtime table values. |

## 3. RTP Model

For any cashout step `k`, the expected return is:

```text
RTP(k) = C(grid_size - mine_count, k) / C(grid_size, k) * multiplier(k)
```

## 5. Anchor Reconciliation

Mines does not have BOXE-style product anchors to derive a new formula in this WP. The anchors are runtime anchors: representative backend lookups must match the frozen JSON exactly.

| Anchor | Runtime multiplier | Analytical RTP |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `9` cells / `1` mines / step `1` | `1.0127` | `0.900178` |
| `9` cells / `8` mines / step `1` | `8.1009` | `0.900100` |
| `16` cells / `3` mines / step `3` | `1.7625` | `0.900134` |
| `25` cells / `3` mines / step `1` | `1.0229` | `0.900152` |
| `25` cells / `3` mines / step `3` | `1.3444` | `0.900163` |
| `36` cells / `12` mines / step `5` | `7.9835` | `0.900100` |
| `49` cells / `24` mines / step `1` | `1.7642` | `0.900102` |
| `49` cells / `48` mines / step `1` | `44.1049` | `0.900100` |

Tolerance declared for this WP: exact multiplier parity with backend runtime table; RTP acceptance band for stress is `0.8999 <= empirical_rtp <= 0.9003`.

## 6. 1M Stress Validation Results

The on-demand stress framework uses a deterministic stratified simulation of the first-safe-reveal cashout strategy. That strategy keeps all 130 configs observable with 1M rounds while validating the same runtime payout table.

| Validation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Backend/runtime parity test | `tests/stress/mines_math/test_mines_simulator_backend_parity.py` |
| Audit log validator | `tools/mines_math_validate_backend.py --output var/audit/mines_math_backend_parity.json` |
| Stress framework | `tests/stress/mines_math/test_mines_math_stress.py` |
| Default stress size | `1,000,000` rounds per config |
| Extensive override | `MINES_STRESS_ROUNDS=10000000` |
| Stress RTP band | `89.99% <= empirical RTP <= 90.03%` |
| CI default | Stress skipped unless `RUN_MINES_STRESS=1` |

Run:

```powershell
$env:RUN_MINES_STRESS='1'
python -m pytest tests/stress/mines_math -q
```

## 7. RNG And Fairness Pattern

Mines uses server-authoritative deterministic seed material. Runtime constants:

| Artifact | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| `fairness_version` | `seed_internal_v2` from `runtime.py`. |
| `server_seed` | Secret server-side seed from active fairness rotation. |
| `server_seed_hash` | SHA-256 commitment persisted and exposed. |
| `nonce` | Monotonic value from `mines_fairness_nonce_seq`. |
| `rng_material` | SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing fairness version, grid size, mine count, nonce and server seed. |
| `mine_positions` | Lowest `mine_count` ranked cell hashes over `sha256(f"{rng_material}:{cell_index}")`. |
| `board_hash` | SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing fairness version, grid size, mine count, mine positions, nonce and rng material. |

The current fairness endpoint reports `user_verifiable = false`; admin verification recomputes server seed hash, mine positions and board hash after joining the stored seed rotation.

## 8. External Validator

Standalone simulator:

```powershell
python tools/mines_math_simulator.py --grid-size 25 --mines-count 3 --bet 1.000000 --seed mines-cert --num-rounds 100000
```

Useful flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--grid-size` | Runtime cell count: one of `9`, `16`, `25`, `36`, `49`. |
| `--mines-count` | Supported mine count for that grid. |
| `--bet` | Decimal bet amount. |
| `--seed` | Deterministic simulator seed/server seed for round-by-round mode. |
| `--num-rounds` | Number of validation rounds. |
| `--cashout-step` | Simulated cashout step; defaults to first safe reveal. |
| `--round-by-round` | Print deterministic round rows with generated mine positions. |

The simulator does not import `backend.app.modules.games.mines.*`. It reimplements JSON loading, multiplier lookup, board generation and RTP calculation independently for audit use.

Backend parity audit log:

```powershell
python tools/mines_math_validate_backend.py --output var/audit/mines_math_backend_parity.json
```

## 9. Stress Framework

On-demand stress tests live in `tests/stress/mines_math/`.

```powershell
$env:RUN_MINES_STRESS='1'
python -m pytest tests/stress/mines_math -q
```

Optional extensive run:

```powershell
$env:RUN_MINES_STRESS='1'
$env:MINES_STRESS_ROUNDS='10000000'
python -m pytest tests/stress/mines_math -q
```

Default stress target: 1M rounds per configuration across all 130 configs. The parity test also verifies simulator-vs-backend multiplier and RNG output for fixed seeds.

## 10. Edge Cases

| Edge case | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Unsupported grid size | Backend `supports_configuration` rejects start; simulator raises validation error. |
| Unsupported mine count | Backend `supports_configuration` rejects start; simulator raises validation error. |
| Cashout before safe reveal | Backend rejects cashout when `safe_reveals_count <= 0`. |
| Safe reveal step outside ladder | Backend does not call lookup outside active flow; simulator raises validation error. |
| Final safe reveal | Backend auto-settles win with current multiplier and exposes mine positions. |
| Mine hit | Backend settles loss at payout `0.000000` and exposes mine positions. |
| Duplicate cell reveal | Backend raises game state conflict. |
| Cell index outside grid | Backend raises validation error. |
| Published title config subset | Runtime table supports all 130 configs; title config may publish only a subset. |
| Payout frontend calculation | Forbidden; frontend displays backend response. |
| Runtime math/RNG/fairness changes | Out of scope for this WP; no production Mines runtime files modified. |

## 11. Math Update 2026-05-18: RTP target raised from 90% to 98%

Product decision on 2026-05-18: Mines demo RTP must be 98%, aligned with BOXE. The 90% table documented above is retained as audit history from `WP-MINES-MATH-CERTIFICATION-READY`; it is no longer the active demo runtime target after this update.

Scope of the update:

| Area | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Runtime target | `98%` demo RTP, hardcoded in the table generation for this WP. |
| Future production target | Planned around `92%`, configurable by environment; future pre-launch WP, not this change. |
| Runtime implementation | Frozen table remains the runtime object loaded by `runtime.py`. |
| Formula owner | External simulator reimplements the formula independently and parity-validates backend table values. |
| Gameplay/API/schema/frontend/RNG/fairness | Unchanged. |

Updated formula:

```text
step_success_probability(1) = (grid_size - mine_count) / grid_size
step_success_probability(n) = (grid_size - mine_count - (n - 1)) / (grid_size - (n - 1))

cumulative_success_probability(k) = C(grid_size - mine_count, k) / C(grid_size, k)
multiplier(k) = round_4(0.98 / cumulative_success_probability(k))

step_success_probability(n) = multiplier(n - 1) / multiplier(n), before 4-decimal rounding
potential_payout = round_6(bet_amount * multiplier(k))
```

The 4-decimal multiplier table creates tiny rounding drift. Across all supported configs and cashout steps, theoretical RTP is:

- Minimum theoretical RTP: `0.979956`
- Maximum theoretical RTP: `0.980039`
- Stress acceptance band: `97.9% <= empirical RTP <= 98.1%`
